name: MRP
fix_description: Add reentrancy guard (nonReentrant modifier) to _sell, or follow checks-effects-interactions pattern to update state before making external calls.
difficulty_reasoning: The exploit is short, but it relies on understanding highly protocol-specific token/WMRP behavior, unusual payable callbacks/fallback flow, and a crafted sequence of token transfers to the token contract itself rather than a standard bug pattern. An experienced auditor could likely reproduce it within 30 minutes to 2 hours after reading the custom logic, but it is not an obvious one-step exploit.
